lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cincinnati Bengals −9.5 with a fair total of 45.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Tennessee Titans pass defence, which sits +0.221 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Tennessee Titans and Cincinnati Bengals have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
